text: *ST利达公告称，公司及顾益明等相关责任人因涉嫌信息披露违法违规，收到中国证券监督管理委员会江苏监管局下发的《行政处罚事先告知书》。2020年至2022年公司发生关联方非经营性资金占用合计17.03亿元，公司未及时披露且相关定期报告存在重大遗漏、虚假记载。江苏证监局拟对公司责令改正、给予警告，并处以900万元罚款；拟对顾益明给予警告，并处以1620万元罚款，同时采取5年证券市场禁入措施；对孙振华等其余4名责任人分别处以210万元至380万元不等罚款。截至2026年4月22日，关联方已归还全部占用资金及利息。本次事项未触及重大违法强制退市情形，最终处罚结果
text_en: *ST Lida announced that the company and related parties, including Gu Yiming, received an "Advance Notice of Administrative Penalty" from the Jiangsu Regulatory Bureau of the China Securities Regulatory Commission for suspected violations of information disclosure laws. From 2020 to 2022, the company incurred non-operating fund occupation by related parties totaling RMB 1.703 billion, which was not disclosed in a timely manner, and relevant periodic reports contained major omissions and false records. The Jiangsu Regulatory Bureau plans to order the company to rectify, issue a warning, and impose a fine of RMB 9 million; plans to issue a warning to Gu Yiming and impose a fine of RMB 16.2 million, along with a 5-year market entry ban; and plans to impose fines ranging from RMB 2.1 million to RMB 3.8 million on four other responsible persons, including Sun Zhenhua. As of April 22, 2026, related parties had returned all occupied funds and interest. This matter does not trigger mandatory delisting for major violations, and the final penalty result...
